handoff: Changes requested, 1 blocking: e2e tier red (73 pass, 3 fail). Intake no longer runs its local git show-ref, so the recovery, base-sync and slice-workflow effect transcripts need rewriting. The ci fix #5 logic itself is sound; unit, typecheck and 8 integration files are green.

findings.title: e2e tier red: three effect transcripts still expect intake's local branch check
findings.detail:
intake no longer calls git.branchExists(root, branch) locally, so the pinned effect transcripts lose the line `spawn repo $ git show-ref --verify --quiet refs/heads/<branch>` before `git ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin ...`. `bun run test:e2e` gives 73 pass, 3 fail: test/e2e/recovery.test.ts › 'a claim lost mid-run > effect transcript' (refs/heads/gh-9-add-search), test/e2e/base-sync.test.ts › 'base sync with real git > effect transcript' (refs/heads/gh-7-add-login-form), and test/e2e/slice-workflow.test.ts › 'a story through the slice workflow > effect transcript' (refs/heads/gh-7-add-login-form). The diff is exactly that one line in each file. The handoff says 'e2e: 74 pass, no pinned file rewritten', which held at c892491c but not at HEAD. AGENTS.md: commit only when green, and pinned outputs change only for an intended behaviour change. This change is intended, so the transcripts must be rewritten with it.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Run `NORN_TRANSCRIPT_UPDATE=1 bun run test:e2e test/e2e/recovery.test.ts test/e2e/base-sync.test.ts test/e2e/slice-workflow.test.ts`, check that each diff only drops the show-ref line, then rerun `bun run test:e2e` to confirm all 76 pass.
